text: A possible wording change, not needed: the verdict belongs to one record (the `record` column, e.g. "1 of 2"), not to the syscall in general. A trace can hold several calls to the same syscall. "for that record" would be more exact than "for that syscall".

The pull request body says the change is "not for merge" and is opened to record which CI jobs a prose-only change starts. That is the author's statement about its purpose. Whether to close or merge it is for a maintainer to decide.
